proofBoundary: Equations are direct semantic normalization of SHA-pinned retail T6 DXBC translated by vkd3d-compiler, validated by spirv-val, reflected/pretty-printed by SPIRV-Cross, and joined to original symbolic resources/constants through DXBC RDEF. Shader-family membership is by exact DXBC SHA-256 only. No generic PBR metallic/roughness interpretation is introduced.

sharedSemantics.encodedTextureDomain: Material color/specular samples are consumed as stored numeric data. RGB is explicitly squared in the retail pixel shader; final output RGB is explicitly square-rooted. Blender/backend color-management must not silently replace those shader operations.

normalVertexDecode.note: This is the exact vertex-shader operation on its D3D vertex input. A source-normalization stage may provide the algebraically decoded vector directly only when equivalence to the retail input-format decode is separately preserved.

lightingLookup.expression: m = max(abs(N.x), abs(N.y), abs(N.z)); lookupUVW = N * lightingLookupScale.xyz / m + gridLightingCoordsAndVis.xyz; modelLighting = sample3D(modelLightingSampler, lookupUVW).rgb^2 * occlusionAmount.z

reflectionLightingRatio.expression: reflectionRatio = max(gridLightingSH(N), 0.1) denominator/inverse pair as emitted by the retail VS: output = max(gridLightingSH(N),0.1) / max(reflectionLightingSH(N),0.1) in the exact translated register order retained by the shader proof
reflectionLightingRatio.note: Backends must consume/reproduce the exact retained VS SH equation rather than infer a physical reflection-probe intensity from this label.

sharedSemantics.outputEncoding: outRgb = sqrt(max-or-source-domain retail arithmetic result after hdrControl0.x multiplication); no generic sRGB transfer function is substituted for the explicit square/sqrt pair

vertexInputs.note: POSITION.w is the retail binormal-sign source used by this VS

normalMap.basis: B = sign(POSITION.w) * cross(N,T); surfaceN = normalize(N + xy.x*T + xy.y*B)
normalMap.note: The retail shader consumes RG only for this normal perturbation. Blender Normal Map/Tangent nodes are not an exact substitute.

families.finalRgb: litRgb = 32 * modelLighting * linearLikeRgb + reflectionRgb; foggedRgb = fogColor + fogVisibility*(litRgb-fogColor); out.rgb = sqrt(foggedRgb * hdrControl0.x)

pipelineStateExample.class: opaque-state selected per Material.stateBitsEntry[techniqueTypeIndex]; family does not hard-code one material state

families.normal: surfaceN = normalize(transformed vertex normal); the Material's identity normalMap is not a pixel-shader resource for this family
families.finalRgb: diffuseRgb = 32 * modelLighting * linearLikeRgb; reflectionUnpremul = reflectionRgb / alphaEncoded; litUnpremul = diffuseRgb + reflectionUnpremul; fogPremul = alphaEncoded*fogColor; premulFogged = fogPremul + fogVisibility*(alphaEncoded*litUnpremul - fogPremul); out.rgb = sqrt(premulFogged * hdrControl0.x)

exactNodeCandidates: material color sampling in Non-Color data mode
globalResourceCapabilitiesRequired: 3D model-lighting lookup or an exact baked equivalent
reflection cube lookup with explicit LOD or an exact baked equivalent
T6 fog/SH/grid-light constants or exact baked equivalents
renderStateLimitations: Blender material nodes do not reproduce arbitrary D3D destination blending exactly; retain T6 pipeline state as authoritative metadata and label any viewport blend mapping as an authoring approximation
forbiddenFallbacks: map T6 specular XYZW to Principled physical parameters without a separate proof
recompute tangent when an exact T6 tangent basis is available
let ordinary sRGB image decoding replace T6's explicit RGB square/sqrt shader operations
